name: splash court: attract loop opens on a home half-court possession (no tip-off) and dwells 3s on the three real play cards
description: Two changes are verified. (1) NO TIP-OFF: SplashCourt now runs testGamePlayHome instead of testGamePlay. testGamePlay is also what the REAL game uses (App.jsx:376/914), so it could not be changed - useGame gained a sibling branch that shares the whole reset block but replaces triggerJumpBall with setupOffense('home'). INITIAL_PLAYERS gives nobody the ball and ensurePGHasBall() returns early when there is no carrier, so the branch also hands home PG (id 1) the ball or the possession would run ball-less. Checked by: no player ever enters the jumpball animation, home PG holds the ball on the first sample, and every one of the 10 players is in the right-hand half (gx >= 55) when the possession starts - INITIAL_PLAYERS sits at gx 34-53 around centre court, HOME_FORMATION at 62-84, so that threshold discriminates the two formations. (2) THE THREE CARDS DWELL: the play gate used to answer at GATE_MS=0 and PlayPickerOverlay was never mounted in the splash at all, so a dwell alone would have been a frozen court with nothing on it. The overlay is now rendered while playPickState is true, and PLAY_GATE_MS=3000 holds it. Checked by: the picker appears with all three real cards, its first contiguous appearance lasts ~3s, it sits at its REAL in-game position with no upward shift (the old PLAY_PICKER_DY=-68 is gone - moving the signature panel off its mark to protect a label was the wrong trade), the TAP TO PLAY CTA is hidden for the duration of the dwell (Frame's hideCta) and returns once the cards go - painting it over the panel instead was tried and looked worse than the original overlap, its cards are pointer-events:none (App.jsx puts onClick=tryExpand on the whole inline container and PlayCard carries its own onClick, so an interactive card would resolve the play early on a tap meant to expand the post), and the possession still proceeds after the gate resolves. Runs in App Desktop/Mobile via App.jsx's DEV-only ?mode=inline override, because Post View is not a WebContentsView and the runner cannot attach to it.

The pre-existing query string is stashed in sessionStorage (survives same-tab navigation) so the final step can put it back - the sibling splash tests blank the whole search on cleanup, which silently strips the preview's own ?view=mobile.

Short settle only. The play gate opens ~1.4s after mount (setupOffense walks the formation in first), so the original 2500ms guaranteed the sampler armed AFTER the picker was already up - which timed only its tail (1898ms of a 3000ms dwell).
ATTRACT='static' has no sim, so every assertion below would be vacuous.

steps._comment: Page-side setInterval at 50ms rather than a runner while-loop: the 3s dwell has to be MEASURED, and per-iteration runner overhead would smear it. Geometry is now read RAW (no transform math): the picker carries no transform any more, so the assertion is that its bbox lands on the real in-game band. The CTA check is presence, counted in both directions: ctaSeen/ctaMissing are only incremented on frames where the picker IS up, and ctaNoPicker only on frames where it is NOT, so one sampler proves both that the CTA yields during the dwell and that it comes back afterwards. TWO trackers, because they answer different questions. Tracker A (pickerFirst/atPicker/geom) captures the FIRST sighting - that is the game-start possession, which is the only one whose formation reflects testGamePlayHome's setupOffense (later home possessions arrive via triggerThrowInHome, which parks the inbounder on the LEFT sideline at gx ~-1). Tracker B (winFirst/winLast) times a window whose ONSET was actually witnessed - it refuses to start until the picker has been seen ABSENT once. Timing tracker A instead is what produced the bogus 1898ms: the picker was already open when sampling began, so only its tail was measured. It also tracks maxBottom: the LOWEST edge the panel reaches on any frame, in parent coords with its own translate folded in. A single sighting is not enough here - cardAnim staggers the cards in from +22px below their resting spot, so the panel's worst frame is its first, not its settled one.
Wait for the play gate to open. setupOffense has to walk the formation into place first, so this is roughly a second in.
Taken while the picker is up - this is the frame the change is about: three cards over a right-half possession, CTA still readable below.

Either way the dwell is measured end to end. Generous max because a full home->away->home cycle can take tens of seconds.
Let the possession run on past the gate, so postAnims can prove the loop did not stall on the new start path.

steps.expression: (() => { const ids = ['probe-no-tipoff','probe-ball-home-pg','probe-right-half','probe-picker-cards','probe-picker-dwell','probe-picker-real-position','probe-cta-yields','probe-picker-inert','probe-loop-runs']; ids.forEach(i => document.querySelectorAll('#' + i).forEach(n => n.remove())); const s = window.__s; const mk = id => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = id; document.body.appendChild(d); }; const out = {}; out.jumpball = s.anims.jumpball || 0; if (!s.anims.jumpball) mk('probe-no-tipoff'); out.firstBall = s.firstBall; if (s.firstBall && s.firstBall.id === 'splash-player-1' && s.firstBall.team === 'home' && s.firstBall.role === 'PG') mk('probe-ball-home-pg'); const pos = s.atPicker || []; const leftOfHalf = pos.filter(p => p.gx === null || p.gx < 55); out.count = pos.length; out.leftOfHalf = leftOfHalf; if (pos.length === 10 && leftOfHalf.length === 0) mk('probe-right-half'); out.cards = s.cards; if (s.cards && s.cards.length === 3) mk('probe-picker-cards'); const dwell = Math.round(s.winLast - s.winFirst); out.dwellMs = dwell; out.firstSightingMs = Math.round(s.pickerLast - s.pickerFirst); out.firstSightingAtSample = s.firstAtSample; if (dwell >= 2500 && dwell <= 4000) mk('probe-picker-dwell'); out.geom = s.geom; out.tf = s.tf; out.minTop = s.minTop === null ? null : Math.round(s.minTop); out.maxBottom = s.maxBottom === null ? null : Math.round(s.maxBottom); out.maxBottomAtSample = s.maxBottomAtSample; if (!s.tf && s.maxBottom !== null && s.maxBottom >= 340) mk('probe-picker-real-position'); out.cta = { whilePicker: s.ctaSeen, missingWhilePicker: s.ctaMissing, whenNoPicker: s.ctaNoPicker }; if (s.ctaSeen === 0 && s.ctaMissing > 0 && s.ctaNoPicker > 0) mk('probe-cta-yields'); out.pointerEvents = s.pe; if (s.pe === 'none') mk('probe-picker-inert'); const act = Object.keys(s.postAnims || {}).filter(k => k !== 'idle'); out.postActions = act; if (act.length > 0) mk('probe-loop-runs'); return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 1: no player ever entered the jumpball animation. Under the old testGamePlay this fired on every restart, so this is the tip-off actually being skipped rather than merely fast.

ASSERTION 2: the very first carrier seen is splash-player-1, home PG. Catches the ball-less-possession trap - INITIAL_PLAYERS hands nobody the ball and ensurePGHasBall() returns early with no carrier, so if the new branch forgot the hasBall assignment the whole possession would run with no ball and this would find no carrier at all.

ASSERTION 3: all ten players are at gx >= 55 when the gate opens, i.e. a right-hand half-court set. INITIAL_PLAYERS is gx 34-53 (centre court, tip-off) and HOME_FORMATION is 62-84, so this distinguishes the two rather than just checking somebody moved.
ASSERTION 4: all three real cards (standard, pickroll, iso) are mounted - the shared PLAYS table from PlayPickerOverlay.jsx, not a splash-local copy.

ASSERTION 5: a picker window whose onset was witnessed lasted 2500-4000ms, i.e. PLAY_GATE_MS=3000 is in force. Fails at the old GATE_MS=0. Measured from tracker B, not the first sighting - the first sighting can start before sampling does, which is exactly how this assertion first reported a false 1898ms.

ASSERTION 6a: the picker sits at its REAL in-game position - no transform attribute at all, and the lowest edge it reaches across the sampled window is at or below y=340 (PlayPickerOverlay's dialog is DLG_Y=232 + DLG_H=116 = 348, and cardAnim's entrance drops the cards a further 22px). Asserted on the BOTTOM edge, not the top: particles rise to y=208 so the group's top edge is not a stable measure of panel position. This replaces the old 'panel stays above y=306' check, which encoded the 68px upward shift that has been removed - moving the game's signature panel off its real mark to protect a label was the wrong trade. With that shift back in place the deepest edge would be 373-68=305 and this fails.

ASSERTION 6b: the TAP TO PLAY CTA yields to the cards rather than the cards moving for it. Three counts, all required: zero frames with the CTA present while the picker is up (whilePicker === 0), at least one frame confirming it was actually absent then (missingWhilePicker > 0, so an all-zero sampler cannot pass this vacuously), and at least one frame with it present while the picker is down (whenNoPicker > 0, so 'hidden' cannot be satisfied by deleting the CTA outright). Painting it on top of the panel instead was tried and rejected: the text lands across the cards' own 'Motion Offense' / '1-on-1 Matchup' / 'SELECT' labels.

ASSERTION 7: computed pointer-events on a play card is 'none'. App.jsx:613 puts onClick=tryExpand on the whole inline container and PlayCard carries its own onClick, so without this a tap meant to expand the post would also resolve the play early and desync the AUTO_PLAY rotation.

ASSERTION 8: at least one non-idle animation fired AFTER the gate resolved, so the possession actually continues. Guards against the new start path satisfying every static check while leaving the loop parked.
